The L=3 module joins two blocks into a6x3 rectangle. A port-independent eight-site reservoir gate demands a vacancy on each of four outer sides and among the four center neighbors. Its154 patterns have particle-count coefficients(1,8,28,52,49,16,0,0,0), giving gamma(p)=q^8+8pq^7+28p^2q^6+52p^3q^5+49p^4q^4+16p^5q^3. Gates of disjoint blocks are independent. A legal antisymmetric configuration-space current H has source sum_b H_b=(sigma_u-sigma_v)g_u g_v. It may traverse bad intermediate gate states and is legal even with occupied exterior. This is a nonzero configuration-space defect, not a zero spatial divergence. The finite graph has262144 configurations,998400 unoriented legal edges and47432 nonzero sources. Numerical flow proposal is rounded to denominator2^40 and integer residual repaired along a forest; exact equations, not solver convergence, justify the finite witness. Overlap weights4 inside blocks and1 at interfaces enter C(p)=E_Q sum_b w_b H_b^2/(2chi gamma^2).

On the coarse lattice, closed dual-edge components C_z come from bad blocks. Average the affine height over each entire component, Psi(z)=mean_{w in C_z} w_2, and take its rotated gradient k. It is conserved and zero on closed edges. With b=1-gamma, M=[[1,2],[2,3]], A=bM and u=(1,1)^T, the source proves P(R_z>=1)<=4b and P(R_z>=r)<=16b^2 u^T A^(r-2)u for r>=2 using shortest distinct-site chordless paths. Condition Delta=1-4b-b^2>0, equivalently b<sqrt(5)-2, yields finite components and m2=4b+32b^2(3-4b+b^2)/Delta^2, Kcal=1+8m2. This supplies integrable stationary correction beta=Psi-z_2 and mean horizontal flux1 without an unknown percolation constant.

The essential lifting coefficient is F_e=k_e(Gamma^{e+}), forcing both endpoint block gates good. It depends only on reservoirs outside the module and stays fixed during every microscopic module transition. Assemble J_b^tile=sum_{e:b in Q_e} F_e H_b^e and average nine translated tilings. The gated source identity and conditional independence of ports reduce admissibility against every local corrector to a finite spatial-divergence pairing. Response is<a,J>=2chi/L and energy||J||^2<=2chi C Kcal/L^2, with c^-1 norm on legal rate-one bonds. The source obtains D>=1/(C Kcal). This preserves N751's exact-local no-go; it does not identify this nonlocal current with an exactly conserved finite-range one.

For R>=1, S=(I-A)^-1 and T_R=16b^2 u^T A^(R-1)[(R+1)^2 I+(2R+3)AS+2A^2S^2]u bound E[R_z^2 1_{R_z>R}]. Resolve beta only within radius R, otherwise zero, take the rotated gradient and clip to open edges. The resulting legal J_R generally is not conserved. The derived ensemble L2 completion bound is||J-J_R||^2<=16chi C T_R/L^2. It is not uniform pointwise error. Component averaging also completes bounded local stationary stream modifications, without a density theorem for this family or a universal defect-completion principle.
